[ASSISTANT_SAID] Common pests affecting strawberries include strawberry aphids, spider mites, Botrytis cinerea, Verticillium wilt, and gray mold.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Prevention methods for pests include removing weeds, keeping the area clean and well-drained, and using insecticidal soap.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Prevention methods for Botrytis cinerea include proper plant spacing, proper irrigation practices, and avoiding overhead watering.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Prevention methods for Verticillium wilt include planting resistant varieties, avoiding over-watering, and avoiding overcrowding.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall prevention includes keeping the area clean, well-drained, and properly irrigated, and choosing disease-resistant varieties.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended disease-resistant strawberry varieties include Albion, Seascape, Sweet Ann, Chandler, and Tristar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] There is no guaranteed immunity to pests and diseases, but planting resistant varieties can help reduce risk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for maintaining healthy strawberries include soil preparation, consistent watering, fertilization every four to six weeks, weed control, pest control, and mulching.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Soil preparation involves mixing compost and organic materials for fertile soil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Strawberries need consistent watering, especially during the fruiting stage, and should avoid soggy soil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A balanced fertilizer should be applied every four to six weeks to provide essential nutrients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Regular inspection for pests is important, and common pests include slugs, snails, and birds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mulching helps retain moisture, prevents weeds, and moderates soil temperature.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Different strawberry varieties have different needs, so check specific requirements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To get the sweetest strawberries, choose sweet varieties like 'Sweet Charlie', 'Chandler', and 'Seascape'.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Strawberries need at least 6-8 hours of sunlight per day for optimal sweetness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Proper irrigation is necessary, as drought or excess moisture can affect flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ensure plants receive enough nutrients, especially potassium, to improve fruit flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Harvest strawberries when fully ripe for the best sweetness.
